brief:
Mujahed Al-Saadi, a Palestinian journalist, was released after nearly two years in Israeli detention and returned to his hometown of Jenin to find the refugee camp drastically transformed, Drop Site News reported. The camp had been emptied and extensively damaged following a large-scale Israeli military operation during his incarceration.

Al-Saadi expressed shock at the scale of destruction, telling the outlet, "I Didn't Expect Jenin Could Change So Much." The 22-month imprisonment meant he had been absent throughout the military assault that reshaped the physical landscape of the camp and displaced residents.
dek: Palestinian journalist Mujahed Al-Saadi returned to his hometown after 22 months in prison to find the Jenin refugee camp emptied and the entire area disfigured by a massive Israeli military assault.
title: Palestinian journalist returns to Jenin after 22 months in Israeli prison
